topic: Banks reorder your daily purchases largest-first so more of them overdraft -- and each overdraft is ~$35
title: How Banks Reorder Your Buys To Maximize Overdraft Fees
description:
Banks can legally change the order of your daily transactions to make more of them overdraft. This is how a single mistake can trigger a cascade of fees.

#personalfinance #banking #overdraft #moneytips #fineprint
